overview: Equestra sits within a masterplan organised around an equestrian Green Core and a branching network of landscaped spaces. Its brochure combines neutral interiors and park-facing homes with shared places for swimming, exercise and informal recreation. The clubhouse, polo fields and stables belong to the wider community setting. The launch material also identifies cycling routes, a forest walk and gardens, alongside play areas for children. Confirm the delivery timetable and any separate access arrangements for the facilities that matter to your household.
locationNote: Grand Polo Club & Resort is in south-west Dubai, with Al Maktoum International Airport, The Oasis and Expo City identified in the launch material as nearby reference destinations. Published journey times are indicative; verify the actual entrance and daily route rather than treating them as a commute guarantee.
priceNote: The official project page advertises AED 3.5m. Equestra’s launch fact sheet instead provides average prices: AED 3.7m for three-bedroom, AED 4.9m for four-bedroom and AED 11.2m for five-bedroom homes. Property Finder labels AED 3.7m as a launch price. These figures have different bases; confirm the selected unit’s current quotation.
paymentNote: The launch structure is 10% on booking, four further 10% instalments, two 15% construction instalments and 20% at estimated completion. The larger intermediate stages are tied to 60% and 80% construction. Past calendar instalments require an updated schedule for a new purchase.
handoverNote: August 2029 is the estimated completion month on the Equestra payment sheet and Property Finder. The contractual completion date and current construction programme require confirmation.
